groups.label: Passed event horizons
groups.meaning: The event horizon has passed and nobody has updated or verified the report since. Check what happened, then rewrite the report in dated past tense.

groups.label: Future-framed language
groups.meaning: The title, summary or notes use language that rots once the date passes.

groups.label: Stale verifications
groups.meaning: The report was last verified against its source too long ago.

groups.label: Never verified
groups.meaning: The report has never been verified against its source.
